facts.fact: Egypt's Ministry of Justice says it has launched a network linking the Real Estate Registry with the communications, planning, housing and awqaf ministries and the survey bodies, with an electronic audit centre, for property registration.
facts.system: Real Estate Registry network and unified digital platform

facts.fact: The Ministry of Justice says a unified digital platform lets a citizen complete the whole property registration cycle remotely, from application to payment and e-signature.
